tool_input.command:
mkdir -p runs/20261101_152928_experiment10 && cp runs/_figbuild_exp10_scratch.py runs/20261101_152928_experiment10/_figbuild.py && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re, json
svg = json.load(open("runs/20261101_152928_experiment10/figure.json"))["architecture_svg"]
texts = re.findall(r"<text[^>]*x='([-\d.]+)' y='([-\d.]+)'[^>]*text-anchor='(\w+)'[^>]*>([^<]*)</text>", svg)
for x,y,a,t in texts:
    print(f"{float(y):7.1f} {float(x):7.1f} {a:7s} {t}")
EOF

result: `runs/20261101_152928_experiment10/figure.json` is written and passes `figcheck`. It diagrams exp 10's canonical-composite reconstruction: the two-member trunk/belief-field/pooling/gate inference path (unchanged, in ink) with the new training-only lane below in red — each member's 8×8 feature map feeding a throwaway decoder that must repaint the three-survey pixel-median composite, MSE×3 added to the loss, discarded before export (berlin.onnx stays byte-identical).
